evidence.title: The Empty Moon Orchid Case
evidence.description: The velvet-lined case is empty. The brass hinges are intact and the fallen petals have not yet browned.

evidence.title: A Lock Opened with Its Key
evidence.description: There are no scratches around the keyway. The case was opened with a greenhouse key, not forced.

evidence.title: The Thermometer's Last Reading
evidence.description: The cracked dial is stopped at 23:40. The visitor book records the gallery as warm and intact at 23:30.

evidence.title: Moss in the Footprints
evidence.description: A trail of damp moss crosses the gallery tiles from the case toward the potting shed. The same green grit is pressed into one pair of boots.

evidence.title: The Night Visitor Book
evidence.description: The book is initialled at 23:30, then left open to a blank line. The storm obscured the next entry, but the gallery was still secure at that time.

evidence.title: The Collector's Advance
evidence.description: A telegram from a private collector promises a large payment for the Moon Orchid. Celia's reply accepts the advance and promises delivery by morning.

evidence.title: Celia Signed Out the Master Key
evidence.description: At 23:20, Celia's initials appear beside the greenhouse master key. Rowan returned his boiler key before the storm began.

evidence.title: Pollen on Celia's Gloves
evidence.description: Fresh Moon Orchid pollen clings to the fingertips of Celia's gloves, folded inside the potting shed bench.

evidence.title: Moss in Celia's Boot Treads
evidence.description: The tread of Celia's boots is packed with the same glasshouse moss pressed into the footprints around the empty orchid case.

evidence.title: Rowan's Boiler Log
evidence.description: Rowan recorded the boiler pressure at 23:40. The needle never moved, and fresh coal dust covers the page beside that entry.

evidence.title: The Orchid Hidden in the Watering Can
evidence.description: A folded strip of waxed paper cushions the Moon Orchid inside the silver can. Its petals are fresh and dusted with blue fertilizer from Celia's gloves.

evidence.title: Celia's Office Alibi
evidence.description: Celia insists she was in the office at 23:40 and never entered the gallery after the storm began.
evidence.note: This is Celia's statement, not an independently verified fact.

evidence.title: Rowan Was at the Boiler
evidence.description: Rowan says he stayed in the boiler room throughout the storm. The pressure log supports his account at 23:40.
evidence.note: A statement supported by the boiler log.

evidence.title: Theo Saw Celia with the Silver Can
evidence.description: Theo saw Celia leave the gallery just before the bell, carrying the silver watering can toward the shed.
evidence.note: Testimony places Celia in the gallery; it does not by itself prove why she was there.
